messages:
Maya (runtime): Quick ping — PR 8031 updates the kernel/path for continuous batching. Need platform + security eyes before I flip the rollout flag.
Rahul (platform): ... can you summarize the config change? Is it a new env var or cluster-level setting?
Maya (runtime): It's a cluster-level flag (enable_kv_compaction=true). Short diff:
```
// enable_kv_compaction toggles aggressive KV cache compaction
if (env["ENABLE_KV_COMPACTION"] == "true") { compact_kv_cache(); }
```
Also changes default batch window from 12ms -> 8ms.
Kevin (infra): rough perf numbers?
Maya (runtime): Local perfbench: 8% lower p99 for small seq (<128), throughput +4% for steady load. CI perf job passed (bench-aws: stable). Link: https://github.com/redwood/pr/8031
Anna (security): Any new secrets or key material? Need to know if KMS/HSM calls are added.
Maya (runtime): No new keys. Just runtime memory compaction. But we touch a path that reads KMS metadata for tenant config (no new perms). I'll add a short sec review checklist.
Rahul (platform): I can review the rollout plan tomorrow AM. We need a canary + 15-min watch window and automatic rollback on error rate spike.
Kevin (infra): I need the bench scripts + the config used to generate numbers. Also, include the migration plan if any stateful changes happen.
Maya (runtime): bench scripts: https://internal.redwood/bench/8031.sh
Maya (runtime): migration: none — only runtime toggle. Will add canary config and smoke tests in the PR description.
CI-bot: perf-check: passed ✅
Anna (security): Please post the commit hash and a brief summary of why compaction doesn't leak tenant metadata. Then I'll sign off.
Maya (runtime): Commit: bc12f9e. TL;DR: compaction only touches in-memory KV cache; no disk writes, no cross-tenant merges. Added unit tests.
Rahul (platform): @Kevin @Anna if you can ack by EOD we can target tomorrow's 02:00 UTC merge window.
Kevin (infra): I'll try to look today; otherwise will confirm by 01:30 UTC.
Anna (security): Acknowledged, will review in next 2 hours, ping me if anything changes.
Maya (runtime): thanks — pinging here so api-team sees dependency: @api-team FYI (no action needed unless rollout flags conflict)
Rahul (platform): noted. :thumbsup:
Maya (runtime): updated PR with canary yaml + smoke tests.
Kevin (infra): LGTM pending bench repro steps — got them, thx.
Anna (security): Security sign-off ✅ (added review comment linking short audit note)
Rahul (platform): Platform approval ✅ — leaving note about rollback thresholds.
Maya (runtime): great, thanks all. I'll schedule merge for 02:00 UTC and post post-merge check list here.
